rationale: AEHR is trading at 88.6% of its intraday range after a 10.8% gap-up on strong earnings news, with price near the session high of $65.85 and already extended well above VWAP ($62.33). The wide bid-ask spread of 55.8 bps and the stock's position near the top of a large range create unfavorable risk/reward for both a long (limited upside to high, large pullback risk) and a short (strong fundamental catalyst and momentum make fading dangerous). With 177 minutes remaining and two working orders already consuming ~8% of buying power, the prudent action is to wait for a cleaner setup.
